summary: Shifts wheel state history buffers, then for each wheel (count from field +0x162C) computes the delta between the current wheel state (48-byte stride array) and the previous wheel state (580-byte stride array) for three position components (+308/+316/+324) and three velocity components (+332/+340/+348), accumulating each delta back into the previous-state buffer so the per-frame change is stored for later interpolation.

local_names.v4: current wheel state element offset (48-byte stride)
local_names.v5: previous wheel state element offset (580-byte stride)

operations.description: Call WheelStateHistoryShift(this) to shift wheel state history buffers forward.
Call BatchIterationWithCounter(this + 1387 words) to obtain the iteration count for the wheel processing loop.
Load wheel state count from field +0x162C into v3.
If wheel count (v3) is greater than 0, process each wheel; otherwise skip the loop.
Loop over wheels while v3 is non-zero; advance current-state offset by 48 bytes and previous-state offset by 580 bytes each iteration.
Compute position deltas: current state value minus previous state value for components at previous offsets +308, +316, +324.
Compute velocity deltas: current state value minus previous state value for components at previous offsets +332, +340, +348.
Accumulate each computed delta back into the previous wheel state buffer (+308, +316, +324, +332, +340, +348).
Return the last computed result value.
